question: Does this certify real color-standard compliance, physical display accuracy or a perceptual quality improvement?

criteria.instruction: No. The profiles are invented one-channel transforms and the samples establish numeric/profile handling only. There is no actual ICC implementation, calibrated display, full-image quality metric, preference study or production asset census. Quantized c only approximates the source intensity under this model.
Cite C21's explicit fictional scope and color limits/sample evidence, separating arithmetic consistency from physical/perceptual claims.
Decline real-standard certification, display calibration/quality gains and complete affected-asset counts from the toy samples.
